scenarios.name: Normal Highway Cruising
scenarios.description: Standard highway driving with normal engine and road vibration.

scenarios.name: Severe Road Pothole Bump (Single Trigger Test)
scenarios.description: Vehicle hits a severe pothole. Accelerometer spikes above 3.0g, but speed is maintained and vehicle remains upright. LifeLink suppresses false trigger!

scenarios.name: Sudden Hard Emergency Braking (Single Trigger Test)
scenarios.description: Driver hits brakes aggressively to avoid animal. Speed drops by 43 km/h (>20 km/h), but impact force is low (<3g) and vehicle is upright. LifeLink suppresses false alarm!

scenarios.name: High-Speed Head-On Collision
scenarios.description: Violent impact against divider or oncoming vehicle. High impact (6.8g) combined with sudden zeroing of speed. Multi-condition validation confirms crash.

scenarios.name: Vehicle Rollover and Ditch Incline
scenarios.description: Vehicle skids off highway into ditch and overturns sideways. Extreme tilt (78.5° > 45°), high deceleration, and impact force confirmed.
